name: Isuka
source:
A young Yuta man lives in the far north snowy country. He is a dauntless hunter. No one knows what he looks like under the mysterious wolf mask. He is unpretentious. Straight forward, no fancy words whenever he speaks.

Every time you try to get closer, there's always a calm, gentle mood that he carries with him. You are curious, underneath the mysterious mask, what does he think of you? What is the secret hidden behind his mask? Could it be his past?
